text: Why did Elizabeth tell Nigel that she was going to the dentist?
zh: 伊丽莎白为什么告诉奈杰尔她要去牙医那儿？
zh_hant: 伊麗莎白為什麼告訴奈傑爾她要去牙醫那兒？

text: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him but he saw me
zh: 我穿过马路想避开他，但他看见了我
zh_hant: 我穿過馬路想避開他，但他看見了我

text: and came running towards me.
It was no use pretending that I had not seen him,
zh: 假装没看见他是没用的，
zh_hant: 假裝沒看見他是沒用的，

text: so I waved to him.
I never enjoy meeting Nigel Dykes.
zh: 我从来不喜欢遇见奈杰尔·戴克斯。
zh_hant: 我從來不喜歡遇見奈傑爾·戴克斯。

text: He never has anything to do.
No matter how busy you are, he
always insists on coming with you.
zh: 总是坚持要跟你在一起。
zh_hant: 總是堅持要跟你在一起。

text: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
zh: 我得想个办法阻止他一整个早上都跟着我。
zh_hant: 我得想個辦法阻止他一整個早上都跟著我。

text: 'Hello, Nigel,' I said 'Fancy meeting you here!'
zh: “你好，奈杰尔，”我说，“真没想到在这儿遇见你！”
zh_hant: “你好，奈傑爾，”我說，“真沒想到在這兒遇見你！”

text: 'Hi, Elizabeth,' Nigel answered.
'I was just wondering how to spend the morning--until
zh: “我刚才正在想怎么度过这个上午——直到
zh_hant: “我剛才正在想怎麼度過這個上午——直到

text: I saw you.
You're not busy doing anything, are you?'
'No, not at all,' I answered.
'I'm going to...'
'Would you mind my coming with you?'
he asked, before I had finished speaking.
'Not at all,' I lied, 'but I'm going to the dentist.'
zh: “不介意，”我撒了谎，“但我要去牙医那儿。”
zh_hant: “不介意，”我撒了謊，“但我要去牙醫那兒。”

text: 'Then I'll come with you,' he answered.
'There's always plenty to read in the waiting room!'
zh: “候诊室里总有很多可以读的东西！”
zh_hant: “候診室裡總有很多可以讀的東西！”
